Explore for grand-total
-- Metrics:
--   this_week_run_km
--   avg_4wk_run_km
WITH "aql__t4" AS (
  -- Metrics:
  --   max(activities.week_start)
  SELECT
    MAX((date_trunc('week', "activities"."start_local")::date)) AS "max_activities->week_start"
  FROM
    activities "activities"
  WHERE
    ("activities"."sport_group" = 'run') AND
    ("activities"."run_surface" = 'road') AND
    (
      (CAST ( (date_trunc('week', "activities"."start_local")::date) AS date ) >= CAST ( '2026-09-21' AS date )) AND
      (CAST ( (date_trunc('week', "activities"."start_local")::date) AS date ) < CAST ( '2026-10-19' AS date ))
    ) AND
    ("activities"."sport_group" IN ('run'))
), "aql__t5" AS (
  -- Dimensions:
  --   activities.week_start
  SELECT
    (date_trunc('week', "activities"."start_local")::date) AS "activities->week_start"
  FROM
    activities "activities"
    CROSS JOIN "aql__t4"
  WHERE
    CAST ( (date_trunc('week', "activities"."start_local")::date) AS date ) = "aql__t4"."max_activities->week_start"
  GROUP BY
    1
), "aql__t6" AS (
  -- Metrics:
  --   sum(activities.distance_m)
  SELECT
    SUM("activities"."distance_m") AS "sum_activities->distance_m"
  FROM
    activities "activities"
    INNER JOIN "aql__t5" "__aql_sm_1__" ON (date_trunc('week', "activities"."start_local")::date) = "__aql_sm_1__"."activities->week_start" OR ((date_trunc('week', "activities"."start_local")::date) IS NULL AND "__aql_sm_1__"."activities->week_start" IS NULL)
  WHERE
    ("activities"."sport_group" = 'run') AND
    ("activities"."run_surface" = 'road') AND
    (
      (CAST ( (date_trunc('week', "activities"."start_local")::date) AS date ) >= CAST ( '2026-09-21' AS date )) AND
      (CAST ( (date_trunc('week', "activities"."start_local")::date) AS date ) < CAST ( '2026-10-19' AS date ))
    ) AND
    ("activities"."sport_group" IN ('run'))
), "aql__t7" AS (
  -- Dimensions:
  --   activities.week_start
  -- Metrics:
  --   sum(activities.distance_m)
  SELECT
    (date_trunc('week', "activities"."start_local")::date) AS "activities->week_start",
    (SUM("activities"."distance_m") / 1000.0) AS "v"
  FROM
    activities "activities"
  WHERE
    ("activities"."sport_group" = 'run') AND
    ("activities"."run_surface" = 'road') AND
    (
      (CAST ( (date_trunc('week', "activities"."start_local")::date) AS date ) >= CAST ( '2026-09-21' AS date )) AND
      (CAST ( (date_trunc('week', "activities"."start_local")::date) AS date ) < CAST ( '2026-10-19' AS date ))
    ) AND
    ("activities"."sport_group" IN ('run'))
  GROUP BY
    1
), "aql__t9" AS (
  -- Metrics:
  --   avg_4wk_run_km
  SELECT
    AVG("aql__t7"."v") AS "avg_v"
  FROM
    "aql__t7"
)
SELECT
  ("aql__t6"."sum_activities->distance_m" / 1000.0) AS "this_week_km",
  "aql__t9"."avg_v" AS "avg_4wk_km"
FROM
  "aql__t6"
  CROSS JOIN "aql__t9"

  filters {

    activities.run_surface is 'road',
    activities.week_start matches @(last 4 weeks),
    activities.sport_group in ['run']
  }
}","columns":[{"name":"this_week_km","fieldName":"this_week_km","label":"this_week_km","adhoc":true,"isMeasure":true,"semantic_type":"number","arrow_type":{"type":"floating_point","precision":"DOUBLE","label":"float64"},"db_type":"DOUBLE"},{"name":"avg_4wk_km","fieldName":"avg_4wk_km","label":"avg_4wk_km","adhoc":true,"isMeasure":true,"semantic_type":"number","arrow_type":{"type":"floating_point","precision":"DOUBLE","label":"float64"},"db_type":"DOUBLE"}],"result":{"fields":["this_week_km","avg_4wk_km"],"records":[["68.17053","46.06198500000001"]]},"has_more":false,"timings":{"steps":[{"step":"compiling_query","start_ms":0},{"step":"connecting_to_dw","start_ms":69},{"step":"executing_query","start_ms":69},{"step":"fetching_query_result","start_ms":71}],"end_ms":72}}}}
